statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is low after orderly post-FOMC price discovery.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold; the next concentrated checkpoint is Thursday's 14:30 Berlin labor/manufacturing data cluster and U.S. cash-open price discovery.
headline: Orderly post-FOMC digestion keeps Tail low ahead of Thursday data
body: Wednesday's FOMC minutes were hawkish, but markets showed limited immediate reaction and the cash session finished modestly higher. After-hours Nasdaq futures were slightly firmer. Hormuz shipping disruption and elevated oil keep Stress extreme, while mixed semiconductor versus megacap evidence does not establish a persistent no-retracement Nasdaq path.

lookbackSummary: The prior 24 hours moved from Tuesday's technology-led block state through pre-FOMC WATCH and then back to low Tail as Wednesday's session showed two-sided price discovery and an orderly reaction to hawkish minutes.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours are low Tail outside a concentrated Thursday 14:30 Berlin data and cash-open window. Event proximity raises Stress and conditional Tail, but a block requires observed persistent one-way NQ structure.

forecast.analysis: After-hours Nasdaq futures are slightly firmer after an orderly post-FOMC cash session. Mixed latest-session semiconductor versus megacap evidence and unresolved Hormuz risk keep Stress extreme, but no fresh persistent no-retracement NQ path is verified.

forecast.analysis: If overnight price discovery stays two-sided, Tail remains low; a renewed directional move would require confirmation from live NQ structure rather than Wednesday's headlines alone.
With no scheduled U.S. macro release in this hour, conditional risk eases if futures continue to retrace normally and cross-asset volatility does not re-accelerate.
Thin overnight liquidity favors a normal baseline; Tail would rise only if fresh NQ extension appears with weak pullbacks and renewed cross-asset alignment.
During the late Asia window, the baseline remains low Tail. A material oil or geopolitical shock would raise Stress first unless NQ itself develops persistent directional efficiency.
Approaching Europe, conditional risk stays low if yields, oil and index futures remain non-aligned; renewed simultaneous pressure would be the main invalidation.
Europe's opening transition can widen ranges. Tail stays low unless live NQ begins holding near an extreme with shallow or failed retracements.
European price discovery becomes more informative. Mixed cross-asset behavior would favor low Tail; broad alignment with persistent NQ extension would lift the score.
By mid-European morning, the focus shifts to whether overnight moves are being retraced. Normal retracements keep Tail low despite persistent geopolitical Stress.
Without a U.S. release in this hour, conditional risk remains dominated by cross-asset confirmation. Tail rises only if live NQ structure becomes unusually one-way.
As U.S. participation approaches, liquidity and direction can strengthen. The forecast remains below WATCH unless persistent NQ extension begins to align with yields, volatility and semiconductors.
Pre-U.S. positioning raises event sensitivity modestly. Tail remains low unless fresh price structure shows failed retracements or an abnormal gap developing.

The 14:30 Berlin labor/manufacturing data cluster is approaching. Event proximity raises Stress and Tail into WATCH territory only conditionally; hypothetical surprise direction is not treated as observed.

Initial Claims and the Philadelphia Fed survey print at 14:30 Berlin within this hour. Tail is WATCH because abrupt repricing is possible, but direction must be confirmed by actual post-release NQ structure.
The U.S. cash open at 15:30 Berlin concentrates opening-auction risk after the 14:30 data. Tail peaks at WATCH; a block would require persistent continuation with shallow or failed pullbacks.
Early cash-session price discovery remains a key checkpoint. Conditional Tail eases if retracements appear and cross-assets stabilize; sustained extension would keep risk elevated.
After the first cash-hour impulse, two-sided trade would support a quick Tail reduction. Continued one-way breadth and semiconductor alignment would be the main adverse condition.
Midday liquidity usually reduces directional efficiency. Tail remains low conditionally unless a catalyst or persistent trend structure overrides normal retracement behavior.
With the main data cluster absorbed, the forecast favors lower Tail if volatility decays. Oil and Hormuz remain Stress drivers but do not alone imply a one-way Nasdaq path.
Late midday risk stays contained conditionally. A fresh geopolitical discontinuity or abrupt rates move would raise Stress immediately and Tail only if NQ follows persistently.
U.S. power-hour participation begins to matter. Tail returns to WATCH if live NQ holds near an extreme with repeated extension; otherwise the baseline remains mixed and recoverable.
Cash-close price discovery can amplify existing trends. Conditional Tail remains below block unless breadth, semiconductors and cross-assets align with a persistent NQ move into the close.
Post-close risk should ease if the cash session ends with normal retracements. Earnings or geopolitical headlines would be reassessed only after any actual market response is observed.
Late post-close conditions return to a normal baseline absent new verified catalysts. Tail remains low unless fresh price discovery establishes a persistent mean-reversion failure.
